scope: Public CPU reconstruction and figure generation; no training or model inference.
analyze.py: Byte-identical to the analyzer frozen before confirmation training.
test_analysis.py: Byte-identical to the frozen analysis test suite.
independent_stats_check.py: Independent adjacent-trapezoid, explicit sign-vector, Holm and confidence-interval reconstruction used to audit released scores.
plot_and_tables.py: Measured-data exporter used for the revised paper; all 160 rows and nonmonotone budgets retained.
reproduce.py: New repository-relative public wrapper. Verifies distributed checksums, metadata, complete grids and frozen statistics; does not regenerate predictions.
dependencies: Exact original GPU environment is recorded in original training receipts. Public CPU dependencies are declared separately; floating-point comparisons allow only numerical rounding tolerance.
verification_boundaries: Public arithmetic and metadata checks remain distinct from the independent saved-array/model verification performed before release.
